meta.listDescription: Sponsors fund a match on tokenized SPYx savings. Deposit, hold, and the match vests.

list.title: The employer match, for people without an employer
list.description: A sponsor funds a match. You deposit SPYx. The match is reserved for you on-chain and vests the longer you stay.
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No pools} one {# pool} other {# pools}}

empty.title: No pools here yet
empty.description: Set a match, fund it, and let savers in. It takes one transaction.

error.title: Can't reach Solana right now
error.description: This list is read straight from the chain. Check your connection and try again.

card.ringLabel: {percent} of the match budget is reserved

demo.note: Vests over {duration} so you can watch it happen. A real pool would vest over months.

instrument.title: Match budget
instrument.ringLabel: {reserved} of {total} {symbol} of match is reserved for savers

rules.title: How this pool works
rules.match: The sponsor matches {percent} of each deposit, first come first served.
rules.cap: Each saver can deposit up to {amount} {symbol}.
rules.vesting: The match vests in a straight line over {duration}, starting when you deposit.
rules.leaveEarly: Leave early and your whole deposit comes back. The part of the match that hasn't vested returns to the sponsor. What has vested stays yours.
rules.reclaim: After the pool closes, the sponsor can reclaim match nobody reserved.

issuer.title: What you actually own
issuer.intro: {symbol} is a tokenized stock. Its issuer keeps some control over the token, and a pool can't change that. Here is what the issuer can do, read live from the chain:

status.paused: Transfers are paused by the issuer

pause.title: Pause transfers
pause.body: While paused, nobody can deposit, claim or withdraw. Funds are stalled, not lost.

freeze.title: Freeze an account
freeze.body: The freeze authority can lock any token account, including this pool's vault.

delegate.title: Move tokens out of any account
delegate.body: A permanent delegate can transfer tokens from any holder, including this pool's vault. The program can't prevent it.

multiplier.title: Change the display multiplier
multiplier.body: Dividends and splits change how many tokens your wallet shows, not how many you hold. Current multiplier: {multiplier}.

issuer.demoNote: This is a demo. Nothing here is an offer of securities, and the program is unaudited.
issuer.loading: Reading the token from the chain…
issuer.unavailable: Couldn't read the token's issuer settings right now.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Every entry was re-read from the chain before it was recorded.
